reference.why: She picked Style 8 on the onboarding form and pasted no demo URL, so Style 8 resolves through demo-design-tokens.md to demo-massage-therapist; its warm-mocha sand-and-shell tones are also the closest library match to her own flyer (a conch on pale sand), her golden-sunset photograph and her stated brand colour of yellows. ONE DELIBERATE DEVIATION from that demo: the hero is hero--showcase hero--showcase-dark rather than the demo's hero--image, and the nav is solid rather than transparent. Her hero photograph is a centred-sun composition, and hero--image dims the whole picture to protect centred text. Measured on the rendered page that treatment could not hold both: deep enough for WCAG AA left the heading at 1.25:1 over the sun and flattened the sunset to brown mud, which is the washed-out failure the Polish Standard names. hero--showcase exists for exactly this case - it disables the overlay entirely and puts the text in a frosted card - so her photograph ships at full vibrancy and the copy is readable.
